name: Dark Spots
description: Dark spots, also known as hyperpigmentation, are areas of the skin that appear darker than the surrounding skin. These spots can be caused by various factors including sun exposure, hormonal changes, and skin damage.
symptoms: Visible changes in color compared to surrounding skin
risk_factors: Use of certain medications (e.g., antibiotics, hormonal treatments)
History of acne or other inflammatory conditions
recommended_product_categories: Serums and Moisturizers Containing Active Ingredients

daily_routine.purpose: Protection against UV rays that can worsen hyperpigmentation.
Maintain skin health and remove impurities without causing irritation.
Hydrate the skin to improve overall texture and appearance.

lifestyle_tips: Protect Your Skin from Sun Exposure
Eat a Balanced Diet Rich in Antioxidants
common_myths: Dark spots can be completely removed with over-the-counter products.
Sun exposure is the only cause of dark spots.
when_to_consult_doctor: If dark spots persist despite home care or if they are accompanied by other symptoms like pain, redness, or swelling.
prevention: Protect Skin with Clothing and Hats

severity_levels.mild: Visible dark spots that do not cover large areas of skin.
severity_levels.moderate: Visible dark spots covering a significant portion of the face or body, affecting self-confidence.
severity_levels.severe: Extensive and noticeable hyperpigmentation requiring professional treatment.

expert_tips: Consistency is key in treating and preventing dark spots. Products containing active ingredients may take several months to show visible results.
Always patch test new products before full application to ensure no adverse reactions occur.
